Revision 103 | Coordinator: /root | v217 COMPLETE: 2/32 cells and 400/432 checks passed. Fix batch 7d89746d pushed with CI skipped; 116 focused support tests and 48 Core tests passed. PCM diagnostic coverage corrected after full branch review; no redundant counter change. Handoff regression and exact WSS payload/PCM diagnosis remain open.
Checkpoint: All 32 cells and 432 checks ran on frozen fc49c300 / generation 416. Two complete cells pass: Mac/local/Chrome WebTransport/EdDSA and ARM/network profile/Chrome WebTransport/ES256. Thirty media checks and two remote-native actor-directory integrity guards fail. Those old cells remain failed. Original controller wait receipt records exit 1; fresh host and ARM census confirms no original controller or guest workload remains and the VM lease is free. Root has now applied the queue, yielding-file-save, duplicate diagnostics, actor-directory and early-VM-release fixes. Combined active-source Python 62 and Node 49 tests pass. Example durability tests are running. G6-054 stays parked.
V217-S1 — Replacement-peer blocking file saves. Owner: media_blockers; reviewer: fixture_blockers. Awaited Tokio saves and the ExitCode cleanup boundary are now applied. Three real durability/privacy/error tests and two owner-cleanup tests each pass with original process exit 0. The broader Mac example run passed 59 tests; six unchanged Linux-only tests rejected macOS before setup, so that whole suite is not qualified. Actual native-stall attribution remains open.
V217-S2 — Shared-SDK cleanup ordering. Owner: fixture_blockers; reviewer: media_blockers. Root reproduced the old queue-ordering failure, applied the fix, and all 18 helper tests pass on the working source. Each exact SDK admits all original ends before long sibling waits. Original deadlines and failure rules remain. Actual Mac timeout attribution is still open.
V217-S3 — WebTransport Opus receive history. Owner: media_blockers; reviewer: v198_resources. Strict compilation and 38 mock tests passed. The real four-case WebCodecs experiment has now run: retained and fresh decoders both classify every frame correctly, including clock-only controls. It does not reproduce the suspected history ambiguity. The decoder-reset change remains staged; Root will not claim it cures the media failure. No WSS cure claim.
V217-S4 — Server-output audio coverage holes. Owner: v198_resources; coordinator: Root. Closed server logs support a pending-currentness refusal near the first output hole; the target belongs to the actual source being handed off. No unrelated Data/global-revision invalidation was found. Source inspection reveals that readiness decodes but drops candidate PCM, while commit can remove the old queue before a new ordinary quantum exists. An actual adoption-boundary counter and conservative continuity design are being staged. Pre-subscription privacy, original age and fresh activation authority remain mandatory; exact attribution of every hole is open.
V217-S5 — Video dropped on transient metadata contention. Owner: v198_resources; reviewer: media_blockers. Root reproduced the old current-Video fragment drop at the intended final oracle after owner cleanup. The one-predicate retry fix is applied and pushed in 7d89746d, with registered controls/production patches and dependency generation 418. All three new controls pass for Video and Screen, including original expiry, revocation and no entered-callback replay; all 45 retained Core tests also pass. Original WSS-loss attribution and fresh matrix verification remain separate.
V217-S6 — WSS/RTC audio-zero frames. Owner: media_blockers; evidence reviewer: v198_resources. Both real WebCodecs and exact public Core Opus history experiments decode cleanly in retained/fresh histories; they do not reproduce the 480-zero frames. Correction: noncurrent captures are discarded and retained PCM stays immutable, so at the actual 48k/no-resampler profile the logged target PCM covers a superset of encoder input. The prior claimed deferred-input coverage gap was wrong; its proposed counter was cancelled. Exact emitted Opus payload to native-browser PCM alignment remains missing; the private bounded diagnostic plan is being corrected. No speculative SSRC rewrite or privacy weakening.
V217-S7 — WSS native decoded timestamp duplicate. Owner: fixture_blockers; reviewer: v198_resources. Bounded diagnostics are now applied; all 31 observer tests pass on the working source, with unchanged keys, limits and failure rules. First/current event details will survive retirement. This does not waive or cure the existing duplicate; exact historical event attribution remains unavailable.
V217-S8 — Remote-native actor-file integrity scope. Owner: media_blockers; reviewer: fixture_blockers. The two-line directory rename is applied. Root reproduced the old final-scope failure; one/three-cycle tests pass and real byte/mode mutations still fail. Combined active-source Python tests pass. Historical actor-file integrity and failed cells are not retroactively promoted.
V217-S9 — Shared-VM test queue. Owner: v198_resources; reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. An actual 22 minute 49 second lease wait exposed avoidable serialization. The fix is now applied: complete all 13 guest calls and integrity/owner/artifact checks, join the original guardian, then decode on the host. All 62 focused tests pass both in isolation and on the working source. Actual timing improvement awaits the next run. Archive custody checks remain intact. A second local ARM VM is a fallback; none was created. No GitHub or cloud testing.
scope: Actual existing-document readback of current checkpoint and nine task paragraphs; historical document content and user edits are preserved.
